description.value:
Actions 10 minutes

Traits Paradise-Touched, mental

Choose up to six willing creatures, who may include you. They gain telepathy with one another permanently, at any distance on the same plane. Any participant can end their own participation at any time as a free action, and you can end the whole thing at any time; a participant who leaves cannot rejoin without you performing this again. You can have only one Congregation active at a time.
